description: Free. Reads a website's public facts: HTTPS and headers, certificate dates, SPF and DMARC, privacy, terms and contact pages, llms.txt, robots.txt and MCP labels. At most 24 requests, one over plain http, and up to 5 of them to its MCP server if it names one. Never logs in or posts forms. Each check: pass, warn, fail or not checked, with fixes. The same domain within 15 minutes gives the stored result. Not a security audit.

domain.description: Like example.com, no https:// or path.

mcp_url.description: Its MCP server if any: https on the same domain, like https://example.com/mcp.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.

name: check_site
title: Run a free site check
